tools.name: get_signals
tools.description: Today's live setups from the ALK board (the same list alktrading.com/today shows): ticker, side, rule, entry, stop and status. Educational only.

tools.name: get_track_record
tools.description: Closed signals from the public record at alktrading.com/record (published since Oct 6, 2026): entry, original stop, dated stop moves, exit, reason and result in R. Losses included.

tools.name: get_backtest
tools.description: Stored historical backtest scores for one ticker (as shown on alktrading.com/scorecards). Reads saved results only; never runs a new backtest. Past results do not predict future results.

tools.name: list_strategies
tools.description: The public rule set ALK signals are built from: id, name, badge and a one-line summary.

tools.name: explain_strategy
tools.description: Plain-English rules for one ALK strategy: the rule, long trigger, short trigger and the market it suits.

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Search ALK's public articles, strategy explanations and key pages. Returns titles, short snippets and alktrading.com links.
